spec.description: Extracting Jira plain fields (no computations) using Infinity plugin - should be able to re-use it

properties.root_selector:
issues.{  
  "Issue Key": key,  
  "Issue ID": id,  
  "URL": self,  
  "Open Date": fields.customfield_10109,  
  "Accepted Date": fields.customfield_10111,  
  "Summary": fields.summary 
}

url_options.data:
{
  "jql": "project=KAN AND issuetype=Incident AND created >= -365d ORDER BY created DESC",
  "maxResults": 1000,
  "expand":"names,fields",
  "fields": [
    "key",
    "id",
    "customfield_10111",
    "customfield_10109",
    "summary"
  ]
}

spec.title: Jira_plain_fields_extraction
